name: The Ritz-Carlton Shanghai, Pudong
insider_take: Soaring 285 meters above the Huangpu River, this sky-high sanctuary occupies floors 53-77 of Shanghai's iconic IFC Tower, making it one of the world's highest hotels.
whats_special: The hotel's signature FLAIR restaurant and bar on the 58th floor offers 360-degree panoramic views of Shanghai's skyline, while the Club Level provides exclusive access to one of Asia's highest executive lounges. Every guest room features floor-to-ceiling windows with breathtaking vistas of either the historic Bund or the futuristic Lujiazui financial district.
pro_tip: Book a Huangpu River view room to watch the nightly light show on the Bund's colonial buildings - it's completely free and runs every evening at 7pm and 8pm.
dont_miss: The hotel's direct connection to the Shanghai IFC Mall puts luxury shopping literally at your doorstep, while the nearby Century Avenue subway station (Line 2) provides seamless access to both Pudong Airport and the historic French Concession in under 30 minutes.
pros: Spectacular panoramic views of Shanghai skyline and Huangpu River
Prime Pudong location with easy access to financial district and attractions
Impeccable Ritz-Carlton service standards and attention to detail
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with world-class treatments
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers
